SCOPE AND TRANSPARENCY

What this does — and doesn't — promise

Media spend is paid separately to Google. No guaranteed leads or bookings. Campaigns require authorised access and an agreed scope.

Common questions

What's the difference between ad spend and management fees?

Money paid to Google for media placement is separate from planning and account-management work.

Do we need a huge budget?

Not necessarily. The test budget should reflect relevant local demand and the objectives agreed.
